name: Octopy Development
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* && sudo mkdir -p /var/lib/apt/lists/partial && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libasound2-dev libjack-dev && pip3 install pygame python-rtmidi pyserial mido pyalsaaudio' && echo "alias run='python3 octo.py --verbose'" >> ~/.bash_aliases && echo "if [ -f ~/.bash_aliases ]; then source ~/.bash_aliases; fi" >> ~/.bashrc
